body:
Claiming B-2026-09-15-15 (passive context awareness - the user/env profile built from incidental conversation signals, no "remember this" trigger).

Intended change (one surface, one commit family):
- backend/src/core/memory_intent.py: extend the passive candidate extractor with location/identity/environment statement cues and time-boxed-ephemeral rejection; canonical_key gains an optional subject-hint so a stated location lands on the same subject:location row the boot deduction writes (restatement replaces, never accumulates).
- backend/src/core/engine/_memory_mixin.py: fold the old inline Path 1 (the plus/minus character-window slice, which double-stored explicit remember-turns under a different key) into the unified candidate pass; every actual passive write emits one visible passive_context_stored event only when _store_fact_if_valid returned True (ADR-64 standing rule); no event on blocked/deduped/volatile-refused.
- backend/src/core/agent_runtime.py: conversational fast-path epilog runs the same passive extraction (today it only runs on the agent-loop path, so facts stated in casual conversation are lost).
- backend/src/api/routes/chat.py: bridge passive_context_stored to a dedicated top-level SSE type (the generic obs_event wrapper is dropped by the frontend - same precedent as reflection_lesson).
- frontend (useLocalMind.ts, CenterPanel.tsx, WorkspaceLayout.tsx): session-scoped passiveMemories log + badge/popover next to the reflection-lesson badge, so what the agent decided to remember on its own is auditable.
- tests: backend unit tests for extractor/gates/dedup/wiring; frontend hook + badge tests.

Why safe to take: single-agent office (roster empty at arrival), current.md was Kamau's completed -13 entry (cleared), no peer claims on the event trail. Paths above are disjoint from every released claim I can see on the trail.

Constraints honored (from the row): -3 policy = durability_profile stays the only accept/refuse authority (volatile statements refused, never stored); -4 mechanics = keyed identity + read-back-confirmed mutation, reused unchanged; ADR-64 = visible, not silent.
